description: Lists training and inference checkpoints owned by the caller, newest first. Filter by type, session, or base model, for example to recover a checkpoint ID for resume.

schema.description: Only return checkpoints produced by this training session
Only return checkpoints trained from this base model. Match is exact.
Maximum number of checkpoints to return (1-100)
Cursor for pagination (ID of the last checkpoint from the previous page)

Only return checkpoints of this type. CHECKPOINT_TYPE_TRAINING is the full training state (weights and optimizer state), for resuming a training session with its optimizer state; CHECKPOINT_TYPE_INFERENCE is a model ready for serving or download, also added to your models. When set, it must be CHECKPOINT_TYPE_TRAINING or CHECKPOINT_TYPE_INFERENCE; when omitted, checkpoints of both types are returned.

base_model.description: Base model the checkpoint was trained from

created_at.description: Timestamp when the checkpoint was created

inference_registration.description: Model registry artifacts to deploy or download this inference checkpoint from. Absent for training checkpoints and when the checkpoint was not uploaded to the registry.

lora_rank.description: LoRA rank of the session that produced this checkpoint. Absent for full-weight sessions and for checkpoints saved before this field was recorded.

session_id.description: Training session that produced the checkpoint

step.description: Training step at time of save

training_registration.description: Model registry artifact holding this training checkpoint's training state, used to resume training rather than to deploy. Absent for inference checkpoints and when the checkpoint was not uploaded to the registry.

type.description: Kind of checkpoint. CHECKPOINT_TYPE_TRAINING is the full training state (weights and optimizer state), for resuming a training session with its optimizer state; CHECKPOINT_TYPE_INFERENCE is a model ready for serving or download, also added to your models.

has_more.description: Whether more items exist beyond this page

limit.description: Maximum number of items returned per page

next_cursor.description: Cursor to use as the 'after' parameter for the next page. Empty when has_more is false.

RL.InferenceCheckpointRegistration.description: Where an inference checkpoint's weights are stored in the Together model registry. At least one of `model` and `adapter` is set.

adapter.description: LoRA adapter weights, deployed on top of the base model. Set for LoRA training on the base model's own weights.

model.description: Full model weights. Set for full-weight training, and for LoRA training on custom base weights, where the merged model is deployed instead of the adapter.

RL.ModelRegistryArtifact.description: A specific revision of a model in the Together model registry

id.description: ID of the model in the Together model registry, as used by the models API

revision_id.description: Revision of the model that holds this checkpoint

RL.CheckpointType.description: Whether a checkpoint is saved for training resume or inference download.
